Blocks.Text: When content is shared, commented or liked from  "What people are talking about now" section on Linkedin.com application, the target of the activity is a ContentTopic Urn of type "urn:li:contentTopic:{id}" . This object is now expanded in Compliance Events API. The schema and example output is shown below.

Rows.Text: A one-liner description of what this ContentTopic is about.
The id of this content topic.
An image urn associated with this content topic.
The Locale for the String fields (name, headline, summary)
The name of this content topic

The state of the content topic. Used to denote where in the workflow this content topic is. Can be one of following:DRAFT: This interest is not ready for prime time yet. It is a work in progressACTIVE*: This interest is active. LinkedIn members can interact with it.EXPIRED: An editor has determined that this Interest is expired, or no longer relevant to any member.FLAGGED: This interest is flagged for review. Most likely the items in the Interest Feed are spammy / low quality / offensive*In Compliance Events API scenario, you should only experience: ACTIVE.
Values: DRAFT: This interest is not ready for prime time yet. It is a work in progress
ACTIVE*: This interest is active. LinkedIn members can interact with it.
EXPIRED: An editor has determined that this Interest is expired, or no longer relevant to any member.
FLAGGED: This interest is flagged for review. Most likely the items in the Interest Feed are spammy / low quality / offensive*In Compliance Events API scenario, you should only experience: ACTIVE.

Rows.Text: A short description of what this ContentTopic is about. Usually no more than a paragraph.
